definitions.gloss: banquet hall; party venue; function room
definitions.explanation: A room or hall specifically designed or designated for hosting banquets, parties, and other gatherings.

examples.japanese: {宴会場|えんかいじょう}を{予約|よやく}した。
ホテルの{宴会場|えんかいじょう}で{結婚|けっこん}{披露宴|ひろうえん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The wedding reception was held in the hotel's banquet hall.

examples.japanese: この{宴会場|えんかいじょう}は{最大|さいだい}{三百人|さんびゃくにん}まで{収容|しゅうよう}できる。
examples.english: This banquet hall can accommodate up to 300 people.

notes:
A compound of {宴会|えんかい} (banquet, party) and {場|じょう} (place, venue). Found in hotels, traditional Japanese inns, and dedicated event facilities. Hotels and ryokan typically have dedicated {宴会場|えんかいじょう} for corporate events, wedding receptions, and year-end parties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{宴会場|えんかいじょう}: large banquet hall
- {宴会場|えんかいじょう}の{予約|よやく}: banquet hall reservation
- {宴会場|えんかいじょう}{付|つ}きのホテル: hotel with a banquet hall

RELATED TERMS:
- {宴会|えんかい}: banquet, party — the event itself
- {披露宴|ひろうえん}: wedding reception
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}: year-end party — one of the most common uses for a banquet hall
- {会場|かいじょう}: venue — more general term for any event venue
